spawn.cmd.spawn: /aspawn [here | go] - show where new characters begin, set it where you stand, or go there
spawn.none: No spawn is set: new characters stay where the game puts them.
spawn.at: New characters begin at {position} cm in {area}.
spawn.not_in_world: You have to be in the world to set the spawn.
spawn.outside_only: The spawn has to be in the outside world, where new characters begin. Go outside first.
spawn.set_failed: The spawn could not be saved and stays where it was. Try again in a moment.
